Definition: Does the government maintain a digital business register?
Comments: ANPI-Gabon’s Guichet Numérique de l’Investissement (GNI) states businesses can be created online via a digital form, indicating partial deployment of digital business registration services.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed by ANPI's own GNI overview document: online registration, e-payment and issuance of the Fiche Unique d'Enregistrement operate nationally and interface with DGI, the Greffe, CNSS and CNAMGS, but RCCM dematerialisation is explicitly noted as still 'in progress' (dossier en cours au Ministère de la Justice). Score of 4 (Partially deployed) confirmed with authoritative primary sources replacing the earlier single weak citation.

Definition: What proportion of the population does the register cover?
Comments: Birth registration completeness (proxy for CRVS uptake) reported at 91% in rural areas (2012), indicating >89% registration among under-5s in that measurement series.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: National (not rural-only) birth-registration completeness was 89.6% in 2012 per World Bank/UNICEF-sourced data, broadly consistent with the 91% rural figure originally cited, and just above the >89% threshold for code 5. However no fresher national survey (DHS/MICS) was located post-2012; code 5 confirmed but flagged for human review given the age and marginal size of the underlying figure.

Definition: Does the government maintain a digital electoral register?
Comments: Ministry of Interior provides an online platform to consult electoral registration using NIP and describes ongoing biometric voter registration with an electoral database, indicating a digital electoral register deployed nationwide.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed and strengthened: nationwide biometric voter registration ran ahead of the 2025 presidential election and the roll was revised again in July-August 2025 for the September legislative/local elections, with automatic enrolment of 18-year-olds from the national biometric file. Fully deployed nationwide (5) confirmed with multiple independent 2025 sources.

Definition: Is the register integrated with the national ID system?
Comments: Electoral list consultation requires NIP (personal identification number), demonstrating the electoral register uses national ID identifier for lookup/verification (at least partial integration).
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Evidence goes beyond mere lookup integration: under Article 48 of the new electoral code the electoral roll is built and updated directly from the national biometric file (fichier national biométrique), and registration is automatic for anyone already enrolled for a NIP — confirmed for both the 2025 presidential and September 2025 legislative/local elections. Upgraded from 4 to 5 (Fully integrated nationwide).

Definition: Is the register integrated with the business register?
Comments: Compliance guidance notes NIF is increasingly linked to RCCM number, suggesting linkage is planned/being strengthened rather than confirmed as fully integrated nationwide.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: ANPI's own GNI process document shows NIF and RCCM numbers are generated through an interfaced workflow within a single online platform (DGI registers the legal acts, the Greffe assigns RCCM, DGI then assigns NIF), and a 2026 guide confirms RCCM and NIF are now issued almost simultaneously (48h) via GNI-ANPI, with a RCCM extract required to obtain a NIF for legal entities. This is beyond 'planned'; upgraded from 2 to 4 (Partially integrated). The original taxdo.com source is a non-authoritative SEO/FAQ site and did not itself substantiate the 'planned' framing.
